name: DescriptionList
title: DescriptionList
summary: Key-value rows for order and giving details, plus a stacked definition list for glossaries.
whenToUse: Key-value `.dp-kv`: order confirmations, giving receipts, station details, account summaries.
Definition list `.dp-dl`: glossaries and "what this means" panels (HD Radio, NFC, BSB).
whenNotToUse: Do not use for many records side by side; use Table.
Do not use for editable settings; use form fields or list rows with switches.

props.name: variant
props.description: `keyValue` is the two-column details list; `glossary` is the stacked term over definition list.

props.name: title
props.description: Key-value only: wrap in `.card.card-flat` with this title row (`.h4`). Omit for a bare list.

props.name: status
props.description: Key-value only: status node (a Badge) shown at the right of the title row.

variantNotes: Key-value: two columns (key up to 180px, value fills), 14px row padding, `--gray-100` hairlines between rows, none above the first.
Total row: `.dp-kv-tot` on both `dt` and `dd`; 18px/600 black with a stronger `--gray-300` rule above.
Value can hold a badge or a small link; the row stays one line where possible.
Definition list: term 16px/600 black over definition 15px `--gray-700`, 20px between pairs.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Keys are `--gray-600`, values `--charcoal-900` at weight 500 and right-aligned.
Put money and IDs in `.dp-num` so digits line up.
Keep the total last. Never colour the total; the weight and rule do the work.
Sit a key-value list inside `.card.card-flat` with a `.h4` title row (`.dp-kv-head`); the status badge goes on the right.
In `.dp-dl`, wrap each `dt`/`dd` pair in a `div`.
Links inside a value use `--horizon-blue`; one that leaves the page ends in ↗.
do: Key-value `.dp-kv`: order confirmations, giving receipts, station details, account summaries.
Definition list `.dp-dl`: glossaries and "what this means" panels (HD Radio, NFC, BSB).
Keys are `--gray-600`, values `--charcoal-900` at weight 500 and right-aligned.
Put money and IDs in `.dp-num` so digits line up.
Keep the total last. Never colour the total; the weight and rule do the work.
Sit a key-value list inside `.card.card-flat` with a `.h4` title row (`.dp-kv-head`); the status badge goes on the right.
In `.dp-dl`, wrap each `dt`/`dd` pair in a `div`.

dont: Do not use for many records side by side; use Table.
Do not use for editable settings; use form fields or list rows with switches.
accessibility: Use real `<dl>`, `<dt>`, `<dd>` so screen readers announce pairs.
Status in a value is a word in a badge, never colour alone.
On narrow screens, values may wrap; do not truncate amounts or order numbers.
content: Keys are short nouns in sentence case: Order number, Placed, Item, Language, Shipping, Total.
Dates written out: 14 October 2026. Currency with symbol and two decimals.
Definitions are one or two plain sentences; no jargon inside the definition.
Mark sample orders and prices as samples in mock-ups.
